2026/02/16 08:36:24 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- 7. Implement get_client_intake_bundle RPC (Authoritative Source of Truth)\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_client_intake_bundle(p_client_id uuid)\nRETURNS jsonb\nLANGUAGE plpgsql\nSECURITY DEFINER\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n  result jsonb;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT jsonb_build_object(\n    'client', (\n      SELECT row_to_json(c)\n      FROM clients c\n      WHERE c.id = p_client_id\n    ),\n    'intake', (\n      SELECT jsonb_build_object(\n        'id', i.id,\n        'client_id', i.client_id,\n        'report_date', i.report_date,\n        'completion_date', i.completion_date,\n        'status', i.status,\n        'details', i.data,\n        'created_at', i.created_at\n      )\n      FROM intakes i\n      WHERE i.client_id = p_client_id\n      ORDER BY i.created_at DESC\n      LIMIT 1\n    ),\n    'documents', (\n      SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(d)), '[]'::jsonb)\n      FROM documents d\n      WHERE d.client_id = p_client_id\n    ),\n    'employment_history', (\n      SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(e)), '[]'::jsonb)\n      FROM employment_history e\n      WHERE e.client_id = p_client_id\n    ),\n    'isp_goals', (\n      SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(g)), '[]'::jsonb)\n      FROM isp_goals g\n      WHERE g.client_id = p_client_id\n    ),\n    'supportive_services', (\n      SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(s)), '[]'::jsonb)\n      FROM supportive_services s\n      WHERE s.client_id = p_client_id\n    ),\n    'follow_up', (\n      SELECT row_to_json(f)\n      FROM follow_ups f\n      WHERE f.client_id = p_client_id\n      ORDER BY f.contact_date DESC\n      LIMIT 1\n    )\n  )\n  INTO result;\n\n  RETURN result;\nEND;\n$$","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/02/16 08:36:24 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- 8. Implement create_client_intake RPC (Transactional Insert)\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION create_client_intake(\n  p_name TEXT,\n  p_phone TEXT,\n  p_email TEXT,\n  p_address TEXT,\n  p_ssn_last_four CHAR(4),\n  p_report_date DATE,\n  p_completion_date DATE,\n  p_intake_data JSONB\n)\nRETURNS JSONB\nLANGUAGE plpgsql\nSECURITY DEFINER\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n  new_client_id UUID;\n  new_intake_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  -- 1. Create Client\n  INSERT INTO clients (name, phone, email, address, ssn_last_four, created_by)\n  VALUES (p_name, p_phone, p_email, p_address, p_ssn_last_four, auth.uid())\n  RETURNING id INTO new_client_id;\n\n  -- 2. Create Intake\n  INSERT INTO intakes (client_id, report_date, completion_date, data, prepared_by, status)\n  VALUES (new_client_id, p_report_date, p_completion_date, p_intake_data, auth.uid(), 'draft')\n  RETURNING id INTO new_intake_id;\n\n  -- 3. Return result\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'client_id', new_client_id,\n    'intake_id', new_intake_id,\n    'success', true\n  );\nEXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', SQLERRM);\nEND;\n$$","ParameterOIDs":null}

CLIENT-USER LINK TABLE\n-- Links authenticated auth.users to their client record\n-- ============================================================================\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS client_users (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    client_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,\n    -- SECURITY: Time-bounded access with automatic expiration\n    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT (NOW() + INTERVAL '30 days'),\n    revoked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,\n    invited_by UUID REFERENCES profiles(id),\n    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),\n    \n    -- Ensure one user maps to one client\n    CONSTRAINT unique_client_user UNIQUE (client_id)\n)","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/02/16 08:36:24 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- Staff can view client_users for clients they manage\nCREATE POLICY \"Staff can view assigned client_users\" ON client_users\n    FOR SELECT TO authenticated\n    USING (\n        EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM clients \n            WHERE clients.id = client_users.client_id \n            AND (clients.assigned_to = auth.uid() OR clients.created_by = auth.uid())\n        )\n        OR\n        -- Admins can see all\n        (SELECT role FROM profiles WHERE id = auth.uid()) IN ('admin', 'supervisor')\n    )","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/02/16 08:36:24 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- Staff can invite clients (insert)\nCREATE POLICY \"Staff can invite assigned clients\" ON client_users\n    FOR INSERT TO authenticated\n    WITH CHECK (\n        EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM clients \n            WHERE clients.id = client_users.client_id \n            AND (clients.assigned_to = auth.uid() OR clients.created_by = auth.uid())\n        )\n        OR\n        (SELECT role FROM profiles WHERE id = auth.uid()) IN ('admin', 'supervisor')\n    )","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/02/16 08:36:24 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- Staff can view activity for assigned clients\nCREATE POLICY \"Staff can view assigned portal_activity\" ON portal_activity\n    FOR SELECT TO authenticated\n    USING (\n        EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM clients \n            WHERE clients.id = portal_activity.client_id \n            AND (clients.assigned_to = auth.uid() OR clients.created_by = auth.uid())\n        )\n        OR\n        (SELECT role FROM profiles WHERE id = auth.uid()) IN ('admin', 'supervisor')\n    )","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/02/16 08:36:24 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- Portal clients can insert their own activity (for logging)\nCREATE POLICY \"Portal clients can log own activity\" ON portal_activity\n    FOR INSERT TO authenticated\n    WITH CHECK (\n        EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM client_users\n            WHERE client_users.id = auth.uid()\n            AND client_users.client_id = portal_activity.client_id\n            AND client_users.is_active = true\n            AND client_users.revoked_at IS NULL\n            AND client_users.expires_at \u003e NOW()\n        )\n    )","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/02/16 08:36:24 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- ============================================================================\n-- 6. PORTAL-SPECIFIC DOCUMENT RLS POLICIES (if documents table exists)\n-- ============================================================================\n\nDO $$\nBEGIN\n    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name = 'documents') THEN\n        -- Drop if exists for re-runs\n        DROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"Portal clients can view own documents\" ON documents;\n        DROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"Portal clients can upload own documents\" ON documents;\n\n        -- Portal clients can view their own documents\n        EXECUTE 'CREATE POLICY \"Portal clients can view own documents\" ON documents\n            FOR SELECT TO authenticated\n            USING (\n                EXISTS (\n                    SELECT 1 FROM client_users\n                    WHERE client_users.id = auth.uid()\n                    AND client_users.client_id = documents.client_id\n                    AND client_users.is_active = true\n                    AND client_users.revoked_at IS NULL\n                    AND client_users.expires_at \u003e NOW()\n                )\n            )';\n\n        -- Portal clients can upload documents for themselves\n        EXECUTE 'CREATE POLICY \"Portal clients can upload own documents\" ON documents\n            FOR INSERT TO authenticated\n            WITH CHECK (\n                EXISTS (\n                    SELECT 1 FROM client_users\n                    WHERE client_users.id = auth.uid()\n                    AND client_users.client_id = documents.client_id\n                    AND client_users.is_active = true\n                    AND client_users.revoked_at IS NULL\n                    AND client_users.expires_at \u003e NOW()\n                )\n            )';\n    END IF;\nEND $$","ParameterOIDs":null}

PORTAL-SPECIFIC CLIENT RLS POLICIES\n-- Portal users can only see sanitized view of their own record\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Drop if exists\nDROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"Portal clients can view own client record\" ON clients","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/02/16 08:36:24 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- Portal clients can view their own client record\nCREATE POLICY \"Portal clients can view own client record\" ON clients\n    FOR SELECT TO authenticated\n    USING (\n        EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM client_users\n            WHERE client_users.id = auth.uid()\n            AND client_users.client_id = clients.id\n            AND client_users.is_active = true\n            AND client_users.revoked_at IS NULL\n            AND client_users.expires_at \u003e NOW()\n        )\n    )","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/02/16 08:36:24 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- ============================================================================\n-- 8. EXPLICIT DENY POLICIES FOR SENSITIVE TABLES (if tables exist)\n-- Defense in depth: Even if application layer fails, DB blocks access\n-- ============================================================================\n\nDO $$\nBEGIN\n    -- Only create policies if report_versions table exists\n    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name = 'report_versions') THEN\n        DROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"Deny portal access to report_versions\" ON report_versions;\n        \n        EXECUTE 'CREATE POLICY \"Deny portal access to report_versions\" ON report_versions\n            FOR ALL TO authenticated\n            USING (\n                EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles WHERE profiles.id = auth.uid())\n            )';\n    END IF;\n\n    -- Only create policies if report_reviews table exists\n    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name = 'report_reviews') THEN\n        DROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"Deny portal access to report_reviews\" ON report_reviews;\n        \n        EXECUTE 'CREATE POLICY \"Deny portal access to report_reviews\" ON report_reviews\n            FOR ALL TO authenticated\n            USING (\n                EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles WHERE profiles.id = auth.uid())\n            )';\n    END IF;\nEND $$","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/02/16 08:36:24 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- ============================================================================\n-- 9. AUTOMATIC EXPIRATION FUNCTION\n-- Runs nightly to revoke expired portal access\n-- ============================================================================\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION revoke_expired_portal_access()\nRETURNS void\nLANGUAGE plpgsql\nSECURITY DEFINER\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n    revoked_count INTEGER;\nBEGIN\n    -- Revoke expired but still active access\n    UPDATE client_users\n    SET \n        is_active = false,\n        revoked_at = NOW()\n    WHERE expires_at \u003c= NOW()\n    AND is_active = true\n    AND revoked_at IS NULL;\n    \n    GET DIAGNOSTICS revoked_count = ROW_COUNT;\n    \n    -- Log the revocation for audit\n    IF revoked_count \u003e 0 THEN\n        INSERT INTO portal_activity (client_id, action, metadata)\n        SELECT \n            client_id,\n            'ACCESS_EXPIRED',\n            jsonb_build_object(\n                'expires_at', expires_at,\n                'revoked_by', 'system_cron',\n                'revoked_at', NOW()\n            )\n        FROM client_users\n        WHERE revoked_at = (SELECT MAX(revoked_at) FROM client_users WHERE revoked_at IS NOT NULL);\n    END IF;\n    \n    RAISE NOTICE 'Revoked % expired portal access records', revoked_count;\nEND;\n$$","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/02/16 08:36:25 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- Get client intake bundle RPC\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_client_intake_bundle(p_client_id uuid)\nRETURNS jsonb\nLANGUAGE plpgsql\nSECURITY DEFINER\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n  result jsonb;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT jsonb_build_object(\n    'client', (\n      SELECT row_to_json(c)\n      FROM clients c\n      WHERE c.id = p_client_id\n    ),\n    'intake', (\n      SELECT jsonb_build_object(\n        'id', i.id,\n        'client_id', i.client_id,\n        'report_date', i.report_date,\n        'completion_date', i.completion_date,\n        'status', i.status,\n        'details', i.data,\n        'created_at', i.created_at\n      )\n      FROM intakes i\n      WHERE i.client_id = p_client_id\n      ORDER BY i.created_at DESC\n      LIMIT 1\n    ),\n    'documents', (\n      SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(d)), '[]'::jsonb)\n      FROM documents d\n      WHERE d.client_id = p_client_id\n    ),\n    'employment_history', (\n      SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(e)), '[]'::jsonb)\n      FROM employment_history e\n      WHERE e.client_id = p_client_id\n    ),\n    'isp_goals', (\n      SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(g)), '[]'::jsonb)\n      FROM isp_goals g\n      WHERE g.client_id = p_client_id\n    ),\n    'supportive_services', (\n      SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(s)), '[]'::jsonb)\n      FROM supportive_services s\n      WHERE s.client_id = p_client_id\n    ),\n    'follow_up', (\n      SELECT row_to_json(f)\n      FROM follow_ups f\n      WHERE f.client_id = p_client_id\n      ORDER BY f.contact_date DESC\n      LIMIT 1\n    )\n  )\n  INTO result;\n\n  RETURN result;\nEND;\n$$","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/02/16 08:36:25 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- HIPAA Compliance: Column-Level Security for PHI\n-- Created: 2026-02-02\n-- Purpose: Restrict access to sensitive PHI fields (SSN, medical records) by role\n\n-- ============================================\n-- 1. Create Masked SSN Function\n-- ============================================\n\n-- Function to mask SSN (show last 4 digits only)\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mask_ssn(ssn TEXT)\nRETURNS TEXT AS $$\nBEGIN\n    IF ssn IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;\n    -- Already masked or short\n    RETURN ssn; \nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER","ParameterOIDs":null}

Audit SSN Access\n-- ============================================\n\n-- Function to log SSN access\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION log_ssn_access()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nBEGIN\n    -- Only log if SSN was actually accessed (not NULL)\n    IF NEW.ssn_last_four IS NOT NULL THEN\n        INSERT INTO audit_logs (\n            user_id,\n            action,\n            resource_type,\n            resource_id,\n            metadata\n        ) VALUES (\n            auth.uid(),\n            'ssn_accessed',\n            'client',\n            NEW.id,\n            jsonb_build_object(\n                'timestamp', NOW(),\n                'masked_ssn', mask_ssn(NEW.ssn_last_four)\n            )\n        );\n    END IF;\n    RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/02/16 08:36:25 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- Function to archive old logs (older than 6 years)\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION archive_old_audit_logs()\nRETURNS TABLE(archived_count BIGINT) AS $$\nDECLARE\n    cutoff_date TIMESTAMPTZ := NOW() - INTERVAL '6 years';\n    count_archived BIGINT;\nBEGIN\n    -- Move to archive table\n    WITH moved AS (\n        INSERT INTO audit_logs_archive \n        SELECT *, NOW() as archived_at\n        FROM audit_logs\n        WHERE created_at \u003c cutoff_date\n        RETURNING *\n    )\n    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO count_archived FROM moved;\n    \n    -- Delete from main table (after successful archive)\n    DELETE FROM audit_logs\n    WHERE created_at \u003c cutoff_date;\n    \n    -- Log the archival action\n    INSERT INTO audit_logs (\n        user_id,\n        action,\n        resource_type,\n        metadata\n    ) VALUES (\n        '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', -- System user\n        'audit_logs_archived',\n        'system',\n        jsonb_build_object(\n            'cutoff_date', cutoff_date,\n            'archived_count', count_archived,\n            'timestamp', NOW()\n        )\n    );\n    \n    RETURN QUERY SELECT count_archived;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER","ParameterOIDs":null}

Partitioning for Performance (Optional)\n-- ============================================\n\n-- Note: If audit_logs table is already created without partitioning,\n-- this section can be applied to new installations or via migration\n\n-- Example partition for current year\n-- CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_logs_2026 PARTITION OF audit_logs\n-- FOR VALUES FROM ('2026-01-01') TO ('2027-01-01');\n\n-- ============================================\n-- 6. Audit Log Integrity Verification\n-- ============================================\n\n-- Function to verify audit log integrity\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION verify_audit_log_integrity()\nRETURNS TABLE(\n    total_logs BIGINT,\n    oldest_log TIMESTAMPTZ,\n    newest_log TIMESTAMPTZ,\n    integrity_status TEXT\n) AS $$\nDECLARE\n    log_count BIGINT;\n    oldest TIMESTAMPTZ;\n    newest TIMESTAMPTZ;\nBEGIN\n    SELECT COUNT(*), MIN(created_at), MAX(created_at)\n    INTO log_count, oldest, newest\n    FROM audit_logs;\n    \n    RETURN QUERY SELECT \n        log_count,\n        oldest,\n        newest,\n        CASE \n            WHEN log_count \u003e 0 THEN 'OK'\n            ELSE 'NO_LOGS'\n        END as integrity_status;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER","ParameterOIDs":null}

AUDIT ARCHIVAL FUNCTION\n-- ============================================================================\n-- Function to move old audit logs to archive table\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION archive_old_audit_logs(days_to_keep int DEFAULT 90)\nRETURNS integer\nLANGUAGE plpgsql\nSECURITY DEFINER\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n  moved_count integer;\nBEGIN\n  -- 1. Insert into archive\n  INSERT INTO audit_logs_archive (id, user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, details, created_at)\n  SELECT id, user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, details, created_at\n  FROM audit_logs\n  WHERE created_at \u003c current_date - (days_to_keep || ' days')::interval;\n  \n  -- 2. Delete from main table\n  WITH deleted_rows AS (\n    DELETE FROM audit_logs\n    WHERE created_at \u003c current_date - (days_to_keep || ' days')::interval\n    RETURNING 1\n  )\n  SELECT count(*) INTO moved_count FROM deleted_rows;\n  \n  RETURN moved_count;\nEND;\n$$","ParameterOIDs":null}

Intake Trends (Daily Counts)\n-- ============================================================================\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_intake_trends(range_days int DEFAULT 30)\nRETURNS TABLE (\n  date date,\n  count bigint\n)\nLANGUAGE plpgsql\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\nBEGIN\n  -- Check permission: Supervisor or Admin only\n  IF NOT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM profiles \n    WHERE id = (select auth.uid()) \n    AND role IN ('supervisor', 'admin')\n  ) THEN\n    RETURN; -- Return empty set for unauthorized users\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN QUERY\n  SELECT\n    created_at::date as date,\n    count(*) as count\n  FROM intakes\n  WHERE created_at \u003e current_date - (range_days || ' days')::interval\n  GROUP BY created_at::date\n  ORDER BY created_at::date ASC;\nEND;\n$$","ParameterOIDs":null}

Staff Workload (Supervisor View)\n-- ============================================================================\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_staff_workload()\nRETURNS TABLE (\n  staff_name text,\n  active_clients bigint,\n  intakes_in_progress bigint\n)\nLANGUAGE plpgsql\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\nBEGIN\n  -- Check permission: Supervisor or Admin only\n  IF NOT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM profiles \n    WHERE id = (select auth.uid()) \n    AND role IN ('supervisor', 'admin')\n  ) THEN\n    RETURN;\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN QUERY\n  SELECT\n    coalesce(p.username, 'Unassigned') as staff_name,\n    count(DISTINCT c.id) filter (where c.status = 'active') as active_clients,\n    count(DISTINCT i.id) filter (where i.status != 'completed') as intakes_in_progress\n  FROM profiles p\n  LEFT JOIN clients c ON c.assigned_to = p.id\n  LEFT JOIN intakes i ON i.client_id = c.id\n  WHERE p.role = 'staff'\n  GROUP BY p.username\n  ORDER BY active_clients DESC;\nEND;\n$$","ParameterOIDs":null}

My Workload (Personal View)\n-- ============================================================================\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_my_workload()\nRETURNS TABLE (\n  active_clients bigint,\n  intakes_in_progress bigint,\n  completed_intakes bigint\n)\nLANGUAGE plpgsql\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\nBEGIN\n  RETURN QUERY\n  SELECT\n    count(DISTINCT c.id) filter (where c.status = 'active') as active_clients,\n    count(DISTINCT i.id) filter (where i.status != 'completed') as intakes_in_progress,\n    count(DISTINCT i.id) filter (where i.status = 'completed') as completed_intakes\n  FROM clients c\n  LEFT JOIN intakes i ON i.client_id = c.id\n  WHERE c.assigned_to = (select auth.uid());\nEND;\n$$","ParameterOIDs":null}

Unified Activity Feed\n-- ============================================================================\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_recent_activity_feed(limit_count int DEFAULT 10)\nRETURNS TABLE (\n  id uuid,\n  event_type text, -- 'intake', 'document', 'note'\n  description text,\n  created_at timestamptz,\n  client_name text\n)\nLANGUAGE plpgsql\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n    user_role text;\nBEGIN\n    SELECT role INTO user_role FROM profiles WHERE id = (select auth.uid());\n    \n    RETURN QUERY\n    WITH merged_activity AS (\n        -- New Intakes\n        SELECT\n            i.id,\n            'intake' as event_type,\n            'New intake started' as description,\n            i.created_at,\n            c.name as client_name,\n            c.assigned_to,\n            c.created_by\n        FROM intakes i\n        JOIN clients c ON i.client_id = c.id\n\n        UNION ALL\n\n        -- New Documents\n        SELECT\n            d.id,\n            'document' as event_type,\n            'Document uploaded: ' || d.name as description,\n            d.uploaded_at as created_at,\n            c.name as client_name,\n            c.assigned_to,\n            c.created_by\n        FROM documents d\n        JOIN clients c ON d.client_id = c.id\n\n        UNION ALL\n\n        -- Follow Ups\n        SELECT\n            f.id,\n            'follow_up' as event_type,\n            'Follow-up completed: ' || f.method as description,\n            f.created_at,\n            c.name as client_name,\n            c.assigned_to,\n            c.created_by\n        FROM follow_ups f\n        JOIN clients c ON f.client_id = c.id\n    )\n    SELECT\n        ma.id,\n        ma.event_type,\n        ma.description,\n        ma.created_at,\n        ma.client_name\n    FROM merged_activity ma\n    WHERE\n        -- Supervisors see all, Staff see assigned\n        (user_role IN ('supervisor', 'admin'))\n        OR\n        (ma.assigned_to = (select auth.uid()) OR ma.created_by = (select auth.uid()))\n    ORDER BY ma.created_at DESC\n    LIMIT limit_count;\nEND;\n$$","ParameterOIDs":null}

Security: Centralized Role Check\n-- ============================================================================\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION check_analytics_access(required_roles text[])\nRETURNS boolean\nLANGUAGE plpgsql\nSTABLE\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n    user_role text;\nBEGIN\n    SELECT role INTO user_role FROM profiles WHERE id = (select auth.uid());\n    \n    -- If user has one of the required roles, return true\n    IF user_role = ANY(required_roles) THEN\n        RETURN true;\n    END IF;\n\n    RETURN false;\nEND;\n$$","ParameterOIDs":null}

Trends\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION analytics_get_intake_trends(range_days int DEFAULT 30)\nRETURNS TABLE (\n  date date,\n  count bigint\n)\nLANGUAGE plpgsql\nSTABLE -- Performance optimization\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n    start_time timestamptz;\n    row_ct int;\nBEGIN\n    start_time := clock_timestamp();\n\n    -- Security Check: Supervisor/Admin only\n    IF NOT check_analytics_access(ARRAY['supervisor', 'admin']) THEN\n        -- Return empty result structure (don't leak existence or error)\n        RETURN;\n    END IF;\n\n    RETURN QUERY\n    SELECT\n        created_at::date as date,\n        count(*) as count\n    FROM intakes\n    WHERE created_at \u003e current_date - (range_days || ' days')::interval\n    GROUP BY created_at::date\n    ORDER BY created_at::date ASC;\n\n    GET DIAGNOSTICS row_ct = ROW_COUNT;\n\n    -- Log usage (fire and forget insert)\n    INSERT INTO analytics_logs (function_name, role, execution_time_ms, row_count)\n    VALUES (\n        'analytics_get_intake_trends', \n        (SELECT role FROM profiles WHERE id = (select auth.uid())),\n        extract(epoch from (clock_timestamp() - start_time)) * 1000,\n        row_ct\n    );\nEND;\n$$","ParameterOIDs":null}

My Workload (Renamed for consistency, accessible by all)\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION analytics_get_my_workload()\nRETURNS TABLE (\n  active_clients bigint,\n  intakes_in_progress bigint,\n  completed_intakes bigint\n)\nLANGUAGE plpgsql\nSTABLE\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n    start_time timestamptz;\nBEGIN\n    -- Accessible by everyone, always returns THEIR stats\n    start_time := clock_timestamp();\n\n    RETURN QUERY\n    SELECT\n        count(DISTINCT c.id) filter (where c.status = 'active') as active_clients,\n        count(DISTINCT i.id) filter (where i.status != 'completed') as intakes_in_progress,\n        count(DISTINCT i.id) filter (where i.status = 'completed') as completed_intakes\n    FROM clients c\n    LEFT JOIN intakes i ON i.client_id = c.id\n    WHERE c.assigned_to = (select auth.uid());\n\n    -- Logging optional for high-frequency user endpoints to save DB writes\n    -- keeping strictly for \"supervisor/admin\" heavy queries is usually enough\n    -- but user asked for \"Log Analytics RPC Usage\", so we log roughly.\n    INSERT INTO analytics_logs (function_name, role, execution_time_ms, row_count)\n    VALUES (\n        'analytics_get_my_workload',\n        (SELECT role FROM profiles WHERE id = (select auth.uid())),\n        extract(epoch from (clock_timestamp() - start_time)) * 1000,\n        1\n    );\nEND;\n$$","ParameterOIDs":null}

Activity Feed (Unified)\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION analytics_get_recent_activity(limit_count int DEFAULT 10)\nRETURNS TABLE (\n  id uuid,\n  event_type text,\n  description text,\n  created_at timestamptz,\n  client_name text\n)\nLANGUAGE plpgsql\nSTABLE\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n    start_time timestamptz;\n    user_role text;\n    row_ct int;\nBEGIN\n    start_time := clock_timestamp();\n    SELECT role INTO user_role FROM profiles WHERE id = (select auth.uid());\n    \n    RETURN QUERY\n    WITH merged_activity AS (\n        SELECT i.id, 'intake' as event_type, 'New intake started' as description, i.created_at, c.name as client_name, c.assigned_to, c.created_by\n        FROM intakes i JOIN clients c ON i.client_id = c.id\n        UNION ALL\n        SELECT d.id, 'document' as event_type, 'Document uploaded: ' || d.name, d.uploaded_at, c.name, c.assigned_to, c.created_by\n        FROM documents d JOIN clients c ON d.client_id = c.id\n        UNION ALL\n        SELECT f.id, 'follow_up' as event_type, 'Follow-up: ' || f.method, f.created_at, c.name, c.assigned_to, c.created_by\n        FROM follow_ups f JOIN clients c ON f.client_id = c.id\n    )\n    SELECT ma.id, ma.event_type, ma.description, ma.created_at, ma.client_name\n    FROM merged_activity ma\n    WHERE\n        (user_role IN ('supervisor', 'admin')) -- Supervisors see all\n        OR\n        (ma.assigned_to = (select auth.uid()) OR ma.created_by = (select auth.uid())) -- Staff see own\n    ORDER BY ma.created_at DESC\n    LIMIT limit_count;\n\n    GET DIAGNOSTICS row_ct = ROW_COUNT;\n\n    INSERT INTO analytics_logs (function_name, role, execution_time_ms, row_count)\n    VALUES (\n        'analytics_get_recent_activity',\n        user_role,\n        extract(epoch from (clock_timestamp() - start_time)) * 1000,\n        row_ct\n    );\nEND;\n$$","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/02/16 08:36:25 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- 3. Global Search RPC\n-- Returns a unified shape for the command palette\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION global_search(\n    query_text text,\n    limit_count int DEFAULT 5\n)\nRETURNS TABLE (\n    type text,\n    id uuid,\n    title text,\n    subtitle text,\n    url text,\n    created_at timestamptz\n) \nLANGUAGE plpgsql\nSECURITY DEFINER -- Use DEFINER to optimize, but filter manually for RLS enforcement\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n    current_user_id uuid;\nBEGIN\n    current_user_id := auth.uid();\n\n    RETURN QUERY\n    -- Search Clients\n    SELECT \n        'client'::text as type,\n        c.id,\n        c.name as title,\n        c.email as subtitle,\n        '/dashboard/clients/' || c.id as url,\n        c.created_at\n    FROM clients c\n    WHERE \n        (\n            to_tsvector('english', c.name || ' ' || c.email || ' ' || coalesce(c.phone, '')) \n            @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', query_text)\n            OR\n            c.name ILIKE '%' || query_text || '%' -- Fallback for partial matches\n        )\n        AND (\n            -- Manual RLS Enforcement logic matching our policies\n            c.assigned_to = current_user_id \n            OR c.created_by = current_user_id\n            OR EXISTS (\n                SELECT 1 FROM profiles p \n                WHERE p.id = current_user_id AND p.role IN ('supervisor', 'admin')\n            )\n        )\n    \n    UNION ALL\n\n    -- Search Documents\n    SELECT \n        'document'::text as type,\n        d.id,\n        d.name as title,\n        left(d.description, 50) as subtitle,\n        d.file_url as url, -- Or link to viewer\n        d.created_at\n    FROM documents d\n    JOIN clients c ON d.client_id = c.id\n    WHERE \n        (\n            to_tsvector('english', d.name || ' ' || coalesce(d.description, '')) \n            @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', query_text)\n             OR\n            d.name ILIKE '%' || query_text || '%'\n        )\n        AND (\n            -- Inherit access from client\n            c.assigned_to = current_user_id \n            OR c.created_by = current_user_id\n             OR EXISTS (\n                SELECT 1 FROM profiles p \n                WHERE p.id = current_user_id AND p.role IN ('supervisor', 'admin')\n            )\n        )\n    \n    ORDER BY created_at DESC\n    LIMIT limit_count;\nEND;\n$$","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/02/16 08:36:25 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- Soft Deletes \u0026 Partial Indexes Optimization\n-- Created: 2026-02-03\n-- Purpose: Support soft deletes and optimize queries for active records\n\n-- 1. Ensure 'deleted_at' column exists (Idempotent)\nDO $$ \nBEGIN\n    -- Clients\n    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'clients' AND column_name = 'deleted_at') THEN\n        ALTER TABLE clients ADD COLUMN deleted_at timestamptz DEFAULT NULL;\n    END IF;\n\n    -- Intakes\n    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'intakes' AND column_name = 'deleted_at') THEN\n        ALTER TABLE intakes ADD COLUMN deleted_at timestamptz DEFAULT NULL;\n    END IF;\n\n    -- Documents\n    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'documents' AND column_name = 'deleted_at') THEN\n        ALTER TABLE documents ADD COLUMN deleted_at timestamptz DEFAULT NULL;\n    END IF;\n\n    -- Documents (Ensure created_at exists for index)\n    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'documents' AND column_name = 'created_at') THEN\n        ALTER TABLE documents ADD COLUMN created_at timestamptz DEFAULT NOW();\n    END IF;\nEND $$","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/02/16 08:36:25 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- Clinical Data Integrity Schema\n-- Created: 2026-02-03\n-- Purpose: Separate Counselor Rationale from Client Claims \u0026 Track History\n\n-- 1. Intake Assessments (Counselor's View)\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS intake_assessments (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n    intake_id UUID REFERENCES intakes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    counselor_id UUID REFERENCES profiles(id) DEFAULT auth.uid(),\n    \n    -- Clinical Rationale\n    verified_barriers TEXT[], -- proven subset of client's 'barriers'\n    clinical_narrative TEXT, -- \"The Story\"\n    \n    -- Eligibility\n    recommended_priority_level INTEGER CHECK (recommended_priority_level BETWEEN 1 AND 3),\n    eligibility_status TEXT CHECK (eligibility_status IN ('pending', 'eligible', 'ineligible')),\n    eligibility_rationale TEXT,\n    \n    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),\n    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()\n)","ParameterOIDs":null}
2026/02/16 08:36:25 PG Send: {"Type":"Bind","DestinationPortal":"","PreparedStatement":"","ParameterFormatCodes":null,"Parameters":[],"ResultFormatCodes":[]}

2026/02/16 08:36:25 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- RLS: Staff can view assessments for clients they are assigned to\nCREATE POLICY \"Staff can view assigned assessments\" ON intake_assessments\n  FOR SELECT TO authenticated\n  USING (EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM intakes\n    JOIN clients ON clients.id = intakes.client_id\n    WHERE intakes.id = intake_assessments.intake_id\n    AND (clients.assigned_to = auth.uid() OR clients.created_by = auth.uid())\n  ))","ParameterOIDs":null}
2026/02/16 08:36:25 PG Send: {"Type":"Bind","DestinationPortal":"","PreparedStatement":"","ParameterFormatCodes":null,"Parameters":[],"ResultFormatCodes":[]}

2026/02/16 08:36:25 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- RLS: Staff can create/edit assessments for assigned clients\nCREATE POLICY \"Staff can manage assigned assessments\" ON intake_assessments\n  FOR ALL TO authenticated\n  USING (EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM intakes\n    JOIN clients ON clients.id = intakes.client_id\n    WHERE intakes.id = intake_assessments.intake_id\n    AND (clients.assigned_to = auth.uid() OR clients.created_by = auth.uid())\n  ))","ParameterOIDs":null}

Intake Events (Immutable History)\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS intake_events (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n    intake_id UUID REFERENCES intakes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    actor_id UUID REFERENCES profiles(id) DEFAULT auth.uid(),\n    \n    event_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'STATUS_CHANGE', 'RATIONALE_UPDATE', 'SUBMITTED'\n    previous_state JSONB,\n    new_state JSONB,\n    \n    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()\n)","ParameterOIDs":null}

-- Migration: 20260207_transactional_rpcs                                                  
-- Description: Implements atomic RPCs for intake versioning and assessment management.    
                                                                                           
-- 1. Atomic Intake Progress Save                                                          
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION save_intake_progress_atomic(                                    
  p_intake_id uuid,                                                                        
  p_data jsonb,                                                                            
  p_summary text,                                                                          
  p_user_id uuid                                                                           
)                                                                                          
RETURNS jsonb                                                                              
LANGUAGE plpgsql                                                                           
SECURITY DEFINER                                                                           
AS $func$                                                                                  
DECLARE                                                                                    
  new_version_id uuid;                                                                     
BEGIN                                                                                      
  -- 1. Update main intake record                                                          
  UPDATE intakes                                                                           
  SET                                                                                      
    data = p_data,                                                                         
    updated_at = NOW(),                                                                    
    updated_by = p_user_id                                                                 
  WHERE id = p_intake_id;                                                                  
                                                                                           
  IF NOT FOUND THEN                                                                        
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Intake record % not found', p_intake_id;                              
  END IF;                                                                                  
                                                                                           
  -- 2. Insert version snapshot                                                            
  INSERT INTO intake_versions (                                                            
    intake_id,                                                                             
    data,                                                                                  
    change_summary,                                                                        
    created_by                                                                             
  )                                                                                        
  VALUES (                                                                                 
    p_intake_id,                                                                           
    p_data,                                                                                
    p_summary,                                                                             
    p_user_id                                                                              
  )                                                                                        
  RETURNING id INTO new_version_id;                                                        
                                                                                           
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(                                                               
    'success', true,                                                                       
    'intake_id', p_intake_id,                                                              
    'version_id', new_version_id                                                           
  );                                                                                       
END;                                                                                       
$func$;                                                                                    
                                                                                           
-- 2. Atomic Assessment Upsert                                                             
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION upsert_intake_assessment_atomic(                                
  p_intake_id uuid,                                                                        
  p_assessment_data jsonb,                                                                 
  p_user_id uuid                                                                           
)                                                                                          
RETURNS jsonb                                                                              
LANGUAGE plpgsql                                                                           
SECURITY DEFINER                                                                           
AS $func$                                                                                  
DECLARE                                                                                    
  v_existing_id uuid;                                                                      
  v_is_locked boolean;                                                                     
  v_result_id uuid;                                                                        
BEGIN                                                                                      
  -- Check for existing record                                                             
  SELECT id, is_locked INTO v_existing_id, v_is_locked                                     
  FROM intake_assessments                                                                  
  WHERE intake_id = p_intake_id;                                                           
                                                                                           
  -- Security check                                                                        
  IF v_existing_id IS NOT NULL AND v_is_locked = true THEN                                 
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Assessment is locked and cannot be modified';                         
  END IF;                                                                                  
                                                                                           
  IF v_existing_id IS NOT NULL THEN                                                        
    UPDATE intake_assessments                                                              
    SET                                                                                    
      verified_barriers = (p_assessment_data->>'verified_barriers')::text[],               
      clinical_narrative = p_assessment_data->>'clinical_narrative',                       
      recommended_priority_level = (p_assessment_data->>'recommended_priority_level')::int,
      eligibility_status = p_assessment_data->>'eligibility_status',                       
      eligibility_rationale = p_assessment_data->>'eligibility_rationale',                 
      verification_evidence = (p_assessment_data->>'verification_evidence')::jsonb,        
      ai_discrepancy_notes = p_assessment_data->>'ai_discrepancy_notes',                   
      ai_risk_score = (p_assessment_data->>'ai_risk_score')::numeric,                      
      updated_at = NOW()                                                                   
    WHERE id = v_existing_id                                                               
    RETURNING id INTO v_result_id;                                                         
  ELSE                                                                                     
    INSERT INTO intake_assessments (                                                       
      intake_id,                                                                           
      counselor_id,                                                                        
      verified_barriers,                                                                   
      clinical_narrative,                                                                  
      recommended_priority_level,                                                          
      eligibility_status,                                                                  
      eligibility_rationale,                                                               
      verification_evidence,                                                               
      ai_discrepancy_notes,                                                                
      ai_risk_score                                                                        
    )                                                                                      
    VALUES (                                                                               
      p_intake_id,                                                                         
      p_user_id,                                                                           
      (p_assessment_data->>'verified_barriers')::text[],                                   
      p_assessment_data->>'clinical_narrative',                                            
      (p_assessment_data->>'recommended_priority_level')::int,                             
      p_assessment_data->>'eligibility_status',                                            
      p_assessment_data->>'eligibility_rationale',                                         
      (p_assessment_data->>'verification_evidence')::jsonb,                                
      p_assessment_data->>'ai_discrepancy_notes',                                          
      (p_assessment_data->>'ai_risk_score')::numeric                                       
    )                                                                                      
    RETURNING id INTO v_result_id;                                                         
  END IF;                                                                                  
                                                                                           
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(                                                               
    'success', true,                                                                       
    'id', v_result_id                                                                      
  );                                                                                       
END;                                                                                       
$func$;                                                                                    
                                                                                           
-- 3. Save Intake Draft                                                                    
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION save_intake_draft(                                              
  p_intake_id uuid,                                                                        
  p_intake_data jsonb,                                                                     
  p_user_id uuid                                                                           
)                                                                                          
RETURNS jsonb                                                                              
LANGUAGE plpgsql                                                                           
SECURITY DEFINER                                                                           
AS $func$                                                                                  
DECLARE                                                                                    
  v_result_id uuid;                                                                        
BEGIN                                                                                      
  IF p_intake_id IS NOT NULL THEN                                                          
    UPDATE intakes                                                                         
    SET                                                                                    
      data = p_intake_data,                                                                
      status = 'draft',                                                                    
      updated_at = NOW(),                                                                  
      updated_by = p_user_id                                                               
    WHERE id = p_intake_id                                                                 
    RETURNING id INTO v_result_id;                                                         
  ELSE                                                                                     
    INSERT INTO intakes (                                                                  
      data,                                                                                
      status,                                                                              
      prepared_by,                                                                         
      updated_by                                                                           
    )                                                                                      
    VALUES (                                                                               
      p_intake_data,                                                                       
      'draft',                                                                             
      p_user_id,                                                                           
      p_user_id                                                                            
    )                                                                                      
    RETURNING id INTO v_result_id;                                                         
  END IF;                                                                                  
                                                                                           
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(                                                               
    'success', true,                                                                       
    'intake_id', v_result_id                                                               
  );                                                                                       
END;                                                                                       
$func$;                                                                                    
                                                                                           
-- 4. Get Latest User Draft                                                                
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_latest_user_draft(                                          
  p_user_id uuid                                                                           
)                                                                                          
RETURNS jsonb                                                                              
LANGUAGE plpgsql                                                                           
SECURITY DEFINER                                                                           
AS $func$                                                                                  
DECLARE                                                                                    
  v_intake_id uuid;                                                                        
  v_data jsonb;                                                                            
BEGIN                                                                                      
  SELECT id, data INTO v_intake_id, v_data                                                 
  FROM intakes                                                                             
  WHERE updated_by = p_user_id AND status = 'draft'                                        
  ORDER BY updated_at DESC                                                                 
  LIMIT 1;                                                                                 
                                                                                           
  IF v_intake_id IS NOT NULL THEN                                                          
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(                                                             
      'found', true,                                                                       
      'intake_id', v_intake_id,                                                            
      'data', v_data                                                                       
    );                                                                                     
  ELSE                                                                                     
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('found', false);                                             
  END IF;                                                                                  
END;                                                                                       
$func$;
